title: Find the Duplicate Number
kidExplanation: Numbers 1…n in a list of n+1 entries. Find the duplicate without mutating (Floyd cycle idea).

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To find the duplicate number in an array, we can treat the array as a linked list where each value points to the next value in the array. This problem is then reduced to finding the cycle in the linked list. We use the Floyd's Tortoise and Hare algorithm to detect the cycle. Once the cycle is detected, we find the entrance of the cycle, which represents the duplicate number.

# Find the Duplicate Number
# Idea: To find the duplicate number in an array, we can treat the array as a linked list where each value points to the next value in the array. This problem is then reduced to finding the cycle in the linked list. We use the F…
# Line comments below keep the same logic as the NeetCode 150 repo solution.

class Solution:
    def findDuplicate(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        slow = nums[0]
        fast = nums[0]

        # Move slow and fast pointers
        while True:
            slow = nums[slow]
            fast = nums[nums[fast]]
            if slow == fast:
                break

        # Find the entrance of the cycle
        slow = nums[0]
        while slow != fast:
            slow = nums[slow]
            fast = nums[fast]

        return slow
